summary: Apple's Media Library is a read-only, deprecated Objective-C model of media sources, groups and objects (the docs point to PhotoKit and the iTunes Library framework instead). BifrOSt scans the Music and Pictures folders in two places (the Music app and the shell Photos code), but it has no app-facing SDK API for read-only media collections, and the source and group hierarchy is missing.

features.apple: MLMediaLibrary, load keys MLMediaLoadFoldersKey, MLMediaLoadIncludeSourcesKey, MLMediaLoadExcludeSourcesKey
features.note: Wave 6 (b13, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. no shared entry point; each app picks its own roots, and there is no include/exclude source filter

features.apple: MLMediaSource, MLMediaSourceType, source identifiers (iTunes, Photos, Movies folder, app-defined folders)
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-03, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no source abstraction; files come from plain folder scans

features.apple: MLMediaGroup, root group, group type identifiers (folders, albums, moments)
features.note: the Music library builds albums and artists from tags; there is no generic group tree or group type identifier

features.apple: MLMediaObject: name, media type, URL, attributes dictionary
features.note: songs and photos have typed structs with tags and times; there is no generic attribute dictionary (Media Object Attribute Keys)

features.apple: MLMediaType (image, audio, movie), type attributes on objects
features.note: type is decided per app by file extension; no shared media-type enum in the SDK

features.apple: Library load runs off the main thread with media-object change notifications
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/jobs.rs (library scan on the dispatch pool); springboard/src/shell/photos/mod.rs (rescan)
features.note: both scans run on worker threads; there is no change notification for other apps to observe

features.apple: read-only snapshot per library instance; reloading is explicit
features.note: the shell Photos code rescans; the Music app builds once from its roots and has no file-watch update path in this module

features.feature: Source-specific identifiers and group types (iTunes, iPhoto, Aperture, Final Cut, GarageBand, Logic, Photos)
features.note: tied to Apple's apps and their libraries; these sources are deprecated in the docs, which point to PhotoKit and the iTunes Library framework

gaps: No app-facing SDK module for read-only media collections (nothing under springboard/sdk/src covers sources, groups or objects).
No source abstraction: Music and Photos each scan their own folders with their own code (springboard/src/shell/photos/library.rs and springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs).
Photo scanning is in the shell (springboard/src/shell/photos/library.rs), not in the SDK, so other apps cannot reuse it.
No generic media-object attribute dictionary; metadata is fixed structs per app.
No change notification for other apps when the photo or music collection changes.
Apple's source-specific identifiers (iTunes, iPhoto, Aperture, Final Cut and similar) have no counterpart and are deprecated in the docs.
